versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the discharge-summary skill.
- Generates structured, comprehensive discharge summaries from provided hospital stay details.
- Ensures standard sections: admission reason, hospital course, diagnoses, procedures, discharge meds, condition, and follow-up.
- Marks missing information clearly without invention—never fabricates diagnoses or medications.
- Includes patient-facing instructions and clinician review reminders for safety.
- Emphasizes clarity, medication reconciliation, and actionable follow-up to support safe clinical handoffs.
